name: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited
about: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the food and beverage processing industry and other allied services in India. It is also involved in the business of restaurant and bar and allied hospitality services. The company was formerly known as Thirdwave Financial Intermediaries Limited and changed its name to UVS Hospitality and Services Limited in March 2025. UVS Hospitality and Services Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.
